@@U00235@@
turns the earth to a riot of colors.
And since no flowers dot the landscape,
he dapples the earth with colorful crowds of
joyous people in all their finery.
Turn around;
look back toward the town from this hilltop.
You can see them there,
streaming out through the gloomy gate:
a throng of many colors,
eager to sun themselves today of all days,
the day of the Lord’s resurrection,
for they, too, are resurrected:
from the damp rooms of their humble homes,
from the manacles of mills and factories,
from the dismal oppression of stuffy attics,
from the crush of narrow, crowded streets,
from the churches’ venerable night,
they have been raised into joyous light.
Look!
Look there!
How quickly the fields and gardens
are sprinkled with thronging crowds,
and boats and pleasure craft on the river
dance along all its length and breadth.
And there!
Do you see?
The last barge takes the current,
loaded near to sinking!
And there!
On the mountains!
Colors flashing on every pathway,
a rainbow of clothes dazzles our sight.
Already I hear the bustle and hum of the village.
Here, here is their heaven,
the people’s heaven,
translation:
@@U00235@@
让大地变得五彩斑斓。
由于风景上没有鲜花点缀，
他用五彩斑斓的人群使大地斑驳
穿着华丽服饰的快乐的人们。
回转;
从这个山顶回望小镇。
你可以在那里看到他们，
从阴暗的大门流出：
一大群颜色各异的人，
渴望在所有日子中的今天晒太阳，
主复活的日子，
因为他们也复活了：
从他们简陋的家中潮湿的房间里，
摆脱磨坊和工厂的束缚，
摆脱闷热阁楼的压抑，
远离狭窄拥挤的街道，
从教堂的庄严之夜，
他们已被提升到喜乐的光中。
看！
看那儿！
田野和花园的速度有多快
到处都是熙熙攘攘的人群，
以及河上的船只和游船
沿着它的长度和宽度跳舞。
在那里！
你看到了吗？
最后一艘驳船顺流而下，
满载濒临沉没！
在那里！
在山上！
每条通道都闪烁着色彩，
彩虹般的衣服让我们眼花缭乱。
我已经听到了村庄的喧嚣和喧闹。
这里，这里是他们的天堂，
人民的天堂，
